evidence.claim: The 20th CPC National Congress amended the Party Constitution to add a goal of gradually realizing common prosperity for all, a people-centered development philosophy, a domestic-economy-centered development pattern, and higher-quality, more equitable, sustainable, and secure development.
evidence.title: 20th CPC National Congress concludes in Beijing, Xi Jinping presides over closing session and delivers important speech
evidence.excerpt: The 20th CPC National Congress amended the Party Constitution to add a goal of gradually realizing common prosperity for all, a people-centered development philosophy, a domestic-economy-centered development pattern, and higher-quality, more equitable, sustainable, and secure development.
evidence.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'Also added to the Party Constitution are statements on gradually realizing the goal of common prosperity for all...'; congress closing-session summary
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official congress summary from the state news service directly records the adopted party-line language for 2022.
evidence.period_fit: Directly covers October 2022 and the ruler-period's core policy orientation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong but indirect attribution: Xi presided over the congress and the language was adopted under his leadership, but it is a collective Party decision rather than a one-person order.
contrary_evidence: Policy language does not itself prove delivery or equitable outcomes.
The same congress also emphasizes Party control and state security, which can cut against welfare in practice.

evidence.claim: China's 2022 basic public-health package included health records, health education, immunization, maternal and child health management, elder care, chronic-disease management, severe mental illness, TB, and special services for rural poor children and other vulnerable groups, with local authorities instructed to ensure timely access.
evidence.title: 关于做好2022年基本公共卫生服务工作的通知
evidence.publisher: National Health Commission of the PRC
evidence.excerpt: China's 2022 basic public-health package included health records, health education, immunization, maternal and child health management, elder care, chronic-disease management, severe mental illness, TB, and special services for rural poor children and other vulnerable groups, with local authorities instructed to ensure timely access.
evidence.source_locator: Section '明确项目内容' / list of 2022 basic public health service items
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary ministry notice describing the service package, target groups, and implementation instructions.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong institutional attribution to the Xi-era central state; still a national-program notice, not a direct personal intervention by Xi.
contrary_evidence: The notice sets requirements but does not measure actual subnational delivery quality.
It shows intended access and coverage, not necessarily equal access everywhere.

evidence.claim: China planned 6.5 million government-subsidized rental homes in 40 key cities to help roughly 13 million people in need of affordable housing, and planned renovation of 219,000 old urban residential communities by 2025.
evidence.title: China to build more subsidized rental homes to meet housing needs
evidence.excerpt: China planned 6.5 million government-subsidized rental homes in 40 key cities to help roughly 13 million people in need of affordable housing, and planned renovation of 219,000 old urban residential communities by 2025.
evidence.source_locator: first and second paragraphs of the housing ministry briefing
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary ministry briefing with concrete housing targets and beneficiary estimates.
evidence.period_fit: Published in 2022 and describes the 2022-2025 housing program under Xi's rule.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to the national policy line under Xi's administration, though implementation is heavily decentralized.
contrary_evidence: This is a multi-year target, not evidence of completed 2022 outcomes.
The source is policy intent, not an independent evaluation of allocation fairness.

evidence.claim: Incomes of people lifted out of poverty grew 14.3% year on year in 2022, faster than rural per-capita disposable income overall, and the rural revitalization administration said it was creating jobs and developing local industries to boost those incomes.
evidence.title: Incomes of people lifted out of poverty jump 14.3 pct in 2022
evidence.excerpt: Incomes of people lifted out of poverty grew 14.3% year on year in 2022, faster than rural per-capita disposable income overall, and the rural revitalization administration said it was creating jobs and developing local industries to boost those incomes.
evidence.source_locator: lead paragraph and the sentence 'The growth rate was 8 percentage points higher than that of per capita disposable income of rural residents'
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official release with exact 2022 income growth figures and policy explanation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to the Xi-era poverty-consolidation and rural-revitalization policy line, though the gains also depend on local and market conditions.
contrary_evidence: The statistic is among people already lifted out of poverty, not the whole population.
Income growth alone does not prove durable escape from vulnerability.

evidence.claim: China said it had consolidated and expanded poverty-alleviation achievements, used a dynamic monitoring and support mechanism to prevent relapse into poverty, and increased follow-up support for poverty-relief relocation, industrial development, infrastructure, and public services.
evidence.title: China makes progress in consolidating poverty alleviation: Official
evidence.excerpt: China said it had consolidated and expanded poverty-alleviation achievements, used a dynamic monitoring and support mechanism to prevent relapse into poverty, and increased follow-up support for poverty-relief relocation, industrial development, infrastructure, and public services.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and the section describing the dynamic monitoring/support mechanism
evidence.source_confidence_reason: State Council Information Office summary of an official press conference with specific mechanisms and support categories.
evidence.period_fit: Directly describes 2022 anti-relapse policy and implementation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong institutional attribution to central policy under Xi; the mechanism is centrally driven but operated through ministries and localities.
contrary_evidence: This shows continued dependence on targeted support after poverty relief, not a universal social floor.
An official briefing is not an independent assessment of effectiveness.

evidence.claim: In 2022, nationwide per-capita disposable income rose 2.9%, rural residents' real income grew faster than urban residents', and real household consumption fell 0.2%.
evidence.title: Household income and consumption expenditure in 2022
evidence.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.excerpt: In 2022, nationwide per-capita disposable income rose 2.9%, rural residents' real income grew faster than urban residents', and real household consumption fell 0.2%.
evidence.source_locator: main results paragraph in the NBS release
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official national statistics release with exact national and rural/urban comparisons.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate attribution: these are national outcomes under Xi's rule, but they also reflect macro shocks and local enforcement beyond central intent.
contrary_evidence: Consumption fell, which cuts against a simple welfare-up story.
Disposable-income growth is modest relative to China's scale and shocks in 2022.

evidence.claim: Fixed-asset investment rose 5.1% in 2022, with infrastructure up 9.4%, manufacturing up 9.1%, and health and social work investment rising strongly in the year-end statistical release.
evidence.title: National investment in fixed assets in 2022
evidence.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.excerpt: Fixed-asset investment rose 5.1% in 2022, with infrastructure up 9.4%, manufacturing up 9.1%, and health and social work investment rising strongly in the year-end statistical release.
evidence.source_locator: main results paragraph and the subsections on investment by sector
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official statistics release with concrete sectoral investment changes relevant to social services and productivity foundations.
evidence.period_fit: Directly reports 2022 spending and investment outcomes.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate attribution: the investment mix reflects central priorities, but actual execution depends on ministries, provinces, and state firms.
contrary_evidence: Strong investment does not automatically prove better service quality or fairness.
Private-sector performance and property-sector weakness temper the welfare interpretation.

evidence.claim: Real estate development investment fell 10.0% in 2022; housing starts fell 39.4%; sales area fell 24.3%; and funding for developers fell 25.9%.
evidence.title: Real estate development and sales in 2022
evidence.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
evidence.excerpt: Real estate development investment fell 10.0% in 2022; housing starts fell 39.4%; sales area fell 24.3%; and funding for developers fell 25.9%.
evidence.source_locator: main results paragraph in the NBS release
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official statistics release giving exact property-sector declines for 2022.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong for national policy context, but not a single-person attribution; the downturn reflects the campaign to rein in leverage and the wider property downturn.
contrary_evidence: The figures point to a major housing-sector stress rather than a clean welfare gain.
These data alone do not show whether any households received offsetting support.

evidence.claim: China created 12.06 million new urban jobs in 2022, but the 16-24 unemployment rate reached 16.7% in December and the statistical bureau said young people faced greater hiring difficulty.
evidence.title: China created 12.06 million new urban jobs in 2022, but youth unemployment hit 16.7 percent in December
evidence.excerpt: China created 12.06 million new urban jobs in 2022, but the 16-24 unemployment rate reached 16.7% in December and the statistical bureau said young people faced greater hiring difficulty.
evidence.source_locator: lead paragraph and the December youth-unemployment sentence
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official labor-market release with specific 2022 headline outcomes and a clear downside indicator.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate attribution: job creation and youth unemployment reflect central macro-management but also property, COVID, and global-demand shocks.
contrary_evidence: Headline job creation is substantial, but youth unemployment is a serious counterweight.
Employment totals do not reveal job quality or distributional fairness.

unresolved_gaps: Direct command-and-control, custody, and launch-discipline evidence is still thin.
Concrete arms-control follow-through beyond declaratory no-first-use language is limited.
Crisis de-escalation evidence in the Taiwan and Russia-Ukraine settings is mostly indirect.
Direct evidence of Xi personally authorizing or restraining specific military moves is thin.
Civilian-protection and operational-conduct evidence during the Taiwan crisis is limited.
Evidence of actual mediation or de-escalation in Russia-Ukraine remains mostly declaratory.
Water, sanitation, and local service-variation evidence is thin compared with health, pensions, housing, and crisis response.
Chain-of-command evidence for specific repression episodes remains limited.
Independent evidence on courts, legislatures, and oversight bodies resisting capture is thin.
Succession and term-limit mechanics could be more directly documented as a de facto transfer-rule breach.
Independent evaluation of implementation quality across provinces and local-government debt stress remains limited.
Distributional evidence beyond averages and poverty-lifted subgroups could be stronger.
Water/sanitation and housing-quality evidence is thinner than health, pensions, and child-welfare evidence.
Independent evaluation of service quality, regional equity, and front-line delivery remains limited.
Direct, ruler-specific evidence on Xi's own assets, gifts, family business interests, or beneficial ownership is missing.
Independent findings on concealment or obstruction tied personally to Xi are absent.
Evidence of truthful correction versus rhetorical anti-corruption messaging is weak.
Independent evaluation of whether loyalist-heavy appointments improved competence or mainly tightened political control is thin.
More subnational evidence on execution quality and correction would strengthen the adaptation story.
Durable causal impact of the COVID rollback and economic stabilization package remains under-audited.
